home.title: OceanAstra — Bringing AI into every enterprise in the Middle East
home.description: OceanAstra is a Dubai-based technology company delivering AI-native organisation solutions (CorpOS), industry management systems (CarSaas, Flying) and integration partnerships that bring the world's best technology to enterprises in the Middle East.

hero.heading: Bringing AI into every enterprise in the Middle East.
hero.lede: OceanAstra is a technology company headquartered in Dubai. We believe technology knows no borders — we bring the world's most advanced productivity to the Middle East, so that every company here has a wider set of choices.

items.title: Vision · AI in every enterprise in the Middle East
items.body: Whether a company was founded in the age of AI or is a long-established business looking for a way to adapt, it should be able to turn AI into real capability at its own pace — not a demonstration, but something that creates value every day.

items.title: Philosophy · Technology without borders
items.body: A wider choice of advanced productivity for more companies. Good technology should not be constrained by geography, language or the size of the company — wherever you are, whichever language you work in, however large your team, it should be within reach.

pillars.heading: Three lines of business, one direction.
pillars.lede: From how a company is organised, to the systems an industry runs on, to bringing proven technology into the region — all three point at the same thing: advanced productivity that is genuinely used inside enterprises here.

items.title: AI Organisation Solutions
items.summary: Management tools built on how work changes in the age of AI — enabling companies founded today, and giving established businesses a route into AI without tearing anything down.
points: CorpOS (built in-house) — an AI-native management platform entered through instant messaging, where the organisation is made up of human colleagues and AI teammates
Or keep the messaging platform you already use and add a CorpOS team of AI teammates to it — Lark + CorpOS, for example
Management capability for newly founded companies, and a step-by-step transition path for established ones

items.title: Industry Management Solutions
items.summary: Either AI teammates who hold defined roles, or AI assistance layered onto existing work — a new way to manage the operations of a specific industry, and a way to bring AI to the systems that industry already runs.
points: CarSaas — an ERP for automotive trading in the Middle East, currently in development and launching soon
Flying — a cross-border trading system for construction and interior fit-out, delivered as a tailored solution that matches how each business actually trades
AI capability added to the systems an industry already runs, without replacing them

items.title: Integration Partnerships
items.summary: Bringing proven technology from around the world into the Middle East: selection, integration, localised delivery and long-term support.
points: Lark — deployment and integration of the all-in-one digital workplace across the region
Amap — mapping and location services for logistics and field operations
From requirement assessment through tenant setup, migration, training and support in three languages

items.title: Understand
items.body: We sit with the people who do the work — not only the people who sign the contract — and map the process as it genuinely runs today, including the spreadsheets nobody admits to.

items.title: Design
items.body: We propose the smallest solution that addresses the real constraint, and we say plainly which parts are standard product, which are configuration, which are custom development, and where AI should enter.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: Phased rollout with a defined scope, a named delivery lead and a fixed acceptance checklist for every phase. Data migration is treated as part of the project, not an afterthought.

items.title: Support
items.body: Named support contacts, agreed response targets and a documented escalation path — in English, Arabic or Chinese, whichever your team works in.

partners.heading: Working alongside the best technology companies.
partners.lede: We partner with proven technology platforms, bring them to enterprise clients across the region, and take responsibility for every step that follows.

about.heading: About OceanAstra.
body: OceanAstra Technologies L.L.C is a technology company registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, holding a commercial licence issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism, Government of Dubai.

We provide AI organisation solutions, industry management solutions and integration partnerships to enterprise clients across the UAE, the wider GCC and Greater China, delivered and supported in English, Arabic and Chinese.

cta.heading: Tell us where you would like to start.
cta.body: Whether you want AI inside your organisation or a system that fits your industry, describe the situation and we will tell you honestly which route applies — and if none of them does, we will say that too.

solutions.title: Solutions — OceanAstra
solutions.description: OceanAstra's three lines of business: AI organisation solutions (CorpOS), industry management solutions (CarSaas, Flying), and integration partnerships bringing global technology to the Middle East.

hero.heading: From the organisation to the industry, AI that actually lands.
hero.lede: Three lines of business, each with its own delivery model. What they share is that we own the result — the software, the data migration, the training and the support that follows.

sections.title: AI Organisation Solutions
sections.lede: Management tools built on how work changes in the age of AI — enabling companies founded today, and helping established businesses make the transition.
body: AI is not only making old processes faster; it is changing the shape of the organisation itself. Once an AI teammate can hold a real role with real responsibilities, the question of how a company should be structured has a new answer.

We work with two kinds of company: those founded in the age of AI, which can be AI-native from day one, and established businesses that need a route into AI which does not require tearing out what already works.

groups.title: Solutions
items: CorpOS (built in-house) — an AI-native management platform entered through instant messaging. The organisation is made up of human colleagues and AI teammates: each AI teammate holds a defined role, defined responsibilities and a defined reporting line, working alongside people in the same space

Your existing messaging platform + a CorpOS team of AI teammates — keep the platform your company already runs on, such as Lark, and add AI teammates into it to take on the work that can be automated, one role at a time

groups.title: Where it applies
items: Companies founded in the age of AI — build the team as human colleagues and AI teammates from day one
Growing small and mid-sized businesses — add capacity through AI teammates instead of headcount alone
Established businesses adopting AI — bring AI into daily operations without replacing existing systems

sections.note: CorpOS is under active development, and we are refining it with a small number of design partners. If you would like to be an early user, we would like to hear from you.

sections.title: Industry Management Solutions
sections.lede: Either AI teammates who hold defined roles, or AI assistance layered onto existing work — a new operating model for a specific industry, and AI capability for the systems it already runs.
body: Generic software struggles to match the operating reality of a specific industry, and industry software often stops at recording what already happened. We work deep inside particular industries and build AI capability directly into the business system.
There are two ways in: AI teammates who take on roles within the process, or AI assistance that strengthens the systems and the people already in place.

groups.title: CarSaas — automotive trading ERP for the region (in development, launching soon)
items: VIN-level inventory with in-transit, in-bond and in-showroom states
Purchase, shipping, customs and landed-cost tracking per unit
Multi-currency purchasing and settlement, with VAT treatment appropriate to UAE requirements
Chassis-to-invoice traceability for audit and warranty claims
Sales pipeline, reservations, deposits and delivery handover

groups.title: Flying — cross-border trading system for construction fit-out (tailored delivery)
items: End-to-end cross-border procurement and trading for the fit-out industry
Supplier, quotation and order collaboration across currencies and languages
Logistics and customs milestone tracking, with delivery dates visible throughout
Cost captured and settled at project level
Delivered as a tailored solution, matching how a particular business trades and runs its projects

groups.title: Across both
items: AI teammates or AI assistance, whichever suits the team as it is today
Arabic, English and Chinese interfaces with correct right-to-left layout
Deployment on your infrastructure or a hosting arrangement we manage
Documented APIs so the system is never a dead end

sections.note: CarSaas is in development and expected to launch shortly. Flying is delivered as a tailored solution and can be adapted to how a particular business trades and runs its projects — tell us about your operation and we will say what would carry over.

sections.title: Integration Partnerships
sections.lede: Bringing proven technology from around the world into the Middle East, and making it land.
body: Technology built elsewhere — for collaboration, productivity and location services — is often mature and proven, but entering this market means crossing distances of language, compliance and local delivery. We are here in Dubai to close that distance.
For enterprises in the region, this means one more proven option. For the technology companies themselves, it means a local partner for the long term.

groups.title: Platforms we work with
items: Lark — messaging, documents, approvals, calendar and company directory brought together as a single digital workplace
Amap — geocoding, routing, fleet visibility and delivery operations for logistics and field teams
Further platforms assessed case by case; we only bring in what we are prepared to stand behind

groups.title: What we take responsibility for
items: Requirement fit assessment before anyone signs anything
Licensing, tenant provisioning and organisation structure setup
Migration from existing tools, including historical data where feasible
Integration with your ERP, finance system or internal applications
Administrator enablement and end-user training
First-line support in English, Arabic and Chinese

about.title: About — OceanAstra
about.description: OceanAstra is a technology company registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, working to bring AI into every enterprise in the Middle East through AI organisation solutions, industry management systems and integration partnerships.

hero.heading: A technology company headquartered in Dubai.
hero.lede: OceanAstra was founded around one clear ambition: to bring AI into every enterprise in the Middle East.

story.heading: Why we exist
paragraphs: The companies that keep this region moving — vehicle traders, fit-out contractors, distributors, logistics operators — run on operating models that are genuinely sophisticated. Their software rarely reflects that. AI creates a rare opening: rather than carrying the weight of an old system forward, a company can move straight to a new way of working.

We believe technology knows no borders. The most advanced productivity in the world — wherever it was built — should be within reach of enterprises here. OceanAstra was set up by people who have implemented enterprise systems from both sides, inside the organisations that run them and inside the vendors that sell them. We based the company in Dubai to do the last part properly: bring the technology here, and make it land.

We work across three lines: AI organisation solutions, including CorpOS, which we build ourselves and where the organisation is made up of human colleagues and AI teammates; industry management solutions, including CarSaas for automotive trading and Flying for cross-border fit-out trading; and integration partnerships that bring proven global platforms into the region. The three inform each other. What we learn delivering other people's products shapes what we build; what we build shapes what we are willing to recommend.

items.title: Say what is true
items.body: Including when the honest answer is that a client does not need us, that a requirement is not worth the money, or that a deadline will not be met. We would rather lose a project than manage someone's expectations dishonestly.

items.title: Fit before features
items.body: A shorter system that matches how the business runs beats a comprehensive one that nobody opens. We measure a project by whether the work moved into the system, not by the size of the module list.

items.title: Stay after go-live
items.body: The value of an enterprise system is created in the two years after launch, not in the launch. Support, iteration and training are part of the engagement, not an upsell.

items.title: Work in your language
items.body: English, Arabic and Chinese — in the interface, in the documentation, in training and on the support line. Not translated at the end, but built in from the start.

items.title: Telephone

items.title: Acknowledgement

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — OceanAstra
privacy.description: How OceanAstra collects, uses, shares and protects personal information through its website, software and mobile applications.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share and protect personal information when you visit our website, contact us, or use software and mobile applications that we provide. We have written it to be read, not to be survived.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: The controller responsible for the personal information described in this policy is the company identified at the end of this document, registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Where we process personal information on behalf of a client — for example, inside a business system we operate for them — that client is the controller and we act as a processor under our agreement with them.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need for a clearly identified purpose:
list: Information you give us — your name, company, email address, telephone number and the content of your message when you contact us or request a demonstration.
Information from using our software — account identifiers, activity and audit records generated as you use a system we provide, and technical logs needed to operate and secure it.
Technical information from our website — IP address, browser type, referring page and pages viewed, collected in standard server logs.
Support information — the content of support requests, including any screenshots, files or device details you choose to send us.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use personal information to:
list: Respond to your enquiry and provide the information or demonstration you asked for
Provide, operate, secure and improve the software and services you or your employer have engaged us for
Provide technical support and communicate about service issues, changes and maintenance
Meet legal, regulatory, tax and accounting obligations that apply to us
Detect, investigate and prevent fraud, abuse and security incidents
after: We do not sell personal information. We do not use the content of client data to train general-purpose AI models.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: Where a legal basis is required, we rely on: performance of a contract with you or your employer; our legitimate interests in operating, securing and improving our business, balanced against your rights; compliance with a legal obligation; and, where applicable, your consent — which you may withdraw at any time.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing and disclosure
paragraphs: We share personal information only in these circumstances:
list: With service providers who host, secure or operate our infrastructure, under written confidentiality and data protection terms
With software vendors whose platforms we integrate or support, strictly as required to provision, license or support your use of those platforms
Where required by applicable law, regulation, court order or a lawful request from a competent authority
In connection with a corporate transaction such as a merger or acquisition, subject to equivalent protection continuing to apply

sections.heading: 6. International transfers
paragraphs: We are based in the United Arab Emirates and work with clients and providers in other countries. Where personal information is transferred across borders, we take reasonable steps to ensure it remains protected to a standard consistent with this policy and with applicable law, including through contractual safeguards with the recipient. Where a client requires data to remain within a specific jurisdiction, we agree that in writing before implementation.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected for, and for any period required by law, contract or a legitimate record-keeping need. Enquiry correspondence is normally retained for up to twenty-four months. Client system data is retained according to the agreement with that client and deleted or returned at the end of the engagement on request.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: We apply administrative, technical and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information, including access control on a need-to-know basis, encryption in transit, logging of administrative actions, and confidentiality obligations on our personnel and subcontractors. No system is completely secure, and we do not claim otherwise; if a breach affects your personal information we will notify affected parties and any relevant authority as required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may ask us to:
list: Confirm whether we hold personal information about you and provide a copy
Correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete
Delete information where there is no continuing lawful basis for us to keep it
Restrict or object to certain processing, including direct marketing
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
after: To exercise any of these, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before acting. If we hold the information as a processor for a client, we will refer your request to that client and support them in responding.

sections.heading: 10. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: This website does not use advertising cookies, cross-site trackers or third-party analytics scripts, and stores nothing on your device — your language choice is carried in the page address rather than saved in your browser. We do use the search engines' own webmaster consoles, which report on data those engines collect themselves and place no tracking on this site. Standard server logs are retained for security and diagnostic purposes.

sections.heading: 11. Children
paragraphs: Our website, software and applications are intended for business use and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our services or in applicable law. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Where a change materially affects how we handle your personal information, we will take reasonable steps to notify you.

sections.heading: 13. How to contact us
paragraphs: Questions, requests or complaints about this policy or about how we handle personal information can be sent to the address below. We aim to respond within one business day and to resolve substantive requests within thirty days.

Attempt to gain unauthorised access to the site, its server or any connected system

Names, marks and product names belonging to other companies referenced on this site remain the property of their respective owners, and their appearance here does not imply any endorsement or relationship beyond what is described in writing.

sections.heading: 5. Information on this site

It does not constitute a quotation, an offer capable of acceptance, or professional advice; product descriptions and capabilities may change as our software develops, and some products remain in development. Anything relied upon commercially should be confirmed with us in writing.

sections.heading: 6. Third-party products and links

We do not control those websites or products and are not responsible for their content, availability, terms or privacy practices. Any third-party software you obtain is governed by that vendor's own terms, which apply in addition to any services we provide around it.

sections.heading: 7. Availability and disclaimer

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the website is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for any indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit, revenue, business, goodwill or data, arising from your use of, or inability to use, this website. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including liability for fraud or for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

sections.heading: 9. Client agreements
paragraphs: Software, implementation, integration and support services are provided under a separate written agreement. Where anything on this website conflicts with that agreement, the signed agreement prevails.

sections.heading: 10. Privacy
paragraphs: Our handling of personal information is described in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the federal laws of the United Arab Emirates. The courts of Dubai have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may revise these terms from time to time. The date shown at the top of this page indicates when they were last updated, and the version published here is the version that applies.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
